journal_lines: §aTapped the wall. §oIt rang hollow — not stone-hollow, crystal-hollow. Different sound. Opened it. Violet inside.
§aThe pick went through easier than expected. §oHollow behind the face. Geode, good size. Still forming inside.
§aGeode in the cave wall, disguised as ordinary rock. §oThe sound gave it away. Cracked it clean.
§aWall that did not sound right. Opened it. §oThe crystals inside were arranged the way only long time arranges things.
§aStruck and the stone rang. Opened it along the seam. §oPurple light from inside. Better than iron today.
§aTook the loose crystals first, then the ones the pick freed. §oLeft the deepest ones in the wall. Too much work for too little.
§aA geode opens once. §oWorked it slowly. Got everything worth getting.
§aThe rock had been growing something secret inside it for a long time. §oNot secret anymore.
